local_report.description: General purpose PDF report. Fills: title, sections (list of {heading, body}), author, date.

local_slides.description: General purpose presentation. Fills: title, slides (list of {title, bullets}), author.

quarterly_report.description: Quarterly business report. Fills: company, quarter, year, highlights (list of strings), metrics (dict of name:value), summary.

meeting_notes.description: Meeting notes template. Fills: meeting_title, date, attendees (list), agenda (list), action_items (list of {owner, task, due}).
